description: The night before the auction, a skilled thief, disguised as a janitor, gains access to the museum after hours.
The thief uses a custom-made lockpick to bypass the display case's security lock.
The display case is carefully opened, and the manuscript is removed, revealing a hidden compartment.
A small, valuable item is found hidden within the manuscript, which was the true target of the theft.
The thief escapes the museum without triggering any alarms, using a pre-planned route.
The archivist, Clara, arrives at the museum the next morning to prepare for the auction and discovers the theft.
Clara realizes that the thief must have had inside help to bypass the museum's security system.
Clara begins to investigate the museum staff, looking for anyone who may have been involved in the theft.
The thief, now in possession of the valuable item, contacts a potential buyer on the black market.
Clara discovers a cryptic message at the crime scene, which may lead her to the thief's identity and the location of the stolen manuscript.
Clara decodes the cryptic message, revealing a possible lead on the thief's accomplice within the museum staff
Clara interviews museum staff members, gathering information about potential suspects and their alibis for the night of the theft
Clara identifies a discrepancy in the staff member's alibi
Clara obtains security footage of the staff member's suspicious activity
